declarations.reason: The run's yard dressing, pickups and barricades are regenerated every run from the zone catalog and run seed, and they move or vanish with the compactor, so they stay runtime-owned. The static silhouette is authored: editor.scene.json places the water-tower crowns, one landmark cluster per yard, crane-leg pylons at each yard seam and the alternating shoulder sentries (scripts/author-corridor.ts), all outside the fenced driving line. The five route-course tracks are runtime-owned whole: their edges, lamps, scatter, landmarks and hazard set-pieces are placed from each track's course and dressing tables in src/game/world/setup.ts, so moving a piece of a course moves its scenery with it.
